Silksong gets a date

By Jane Doe

Team Cherry has confirmed that Hollow Knight: Silksong will launch on a specific date after years of waiting, and the community has reacted with a mix of relief and disbelief across every platform where fans gather to discuss the game.

The announcement came during a short presentation, where the studio showed new footage of areas, bosses and the traversal tools that players will use to explore the kingdom of Pharloom. The developers also confirmed the price and the platforms.

Reviewers who tried the game early described a faster and more demanding sequel, with a bigger map and many more optional encounters than the original, which kept the series loyal audience busy for hundreds of hours.
